claims.quote: The symbolic solver represents exact multivariate polynomials (including `number/power` with non-negative integer literal exponents) to cancel higher-degree terms automatically and decides univariate quadratic equations and inequalities over reals and integers via exact rational discriminant roots and BigInt integer root bracketing, closing corpus gap `induction-sum-of-odd-numbers`.
The symbolic solver cancels higher-degree polynomial terms and decides univariate quadratic equations and inequalities over integers and reals.
